Name: DeserokUtils
Author: deserokk
Description:
Small quality-of-life utilities, one feature per tab.

CastWatch: gate a macro line on whether an action actually went off -- including instant casts and oGCDs, which have no cast bar to observe. It never sends anything on your behalf; it only runs or suppresses a line you already wrote.

FateWatch: warn before a cyclic FATE spawns, predicted from the last spawn it actually saw. Says 'not seen yet' rather than inventing a number.

FcBuffs: keep the Free Company buffs running, refreshed from the FC's existing stock in cities and residential districts. Spends no credits -- activating an action the FC already bought is free.

DrawSheathe: one key that draws or sheathes, whichever is currently correct. The Gold Saucer draw and sheathe animations are separate emotes rather than replacements for the default weapon toggle, so they cannot be bound as a toggle and take two hotbar slots. /drawsheathe reads whether your weapon is out and plays the right one. The emote is silently refused while you are moving or jumping, so those fall back to the game's own draw/sheathe and a single key covers every case. Both emote commands are configurable, and a held key collapses to one toggle.

EmoteQuiet: announce an emote the first time, then stay quiet about repeats of that same emote for a minute. Clapping through a whole performance says you clapped once instead of fifty times. Optionally hides other people's repeats from your own log too, kept per sender.

Mouseover: /ifmo runs a macro line with <mo> only when the action would actually land on what you are pointing at, and without it otherwise -- one line instead of a twelve-line mouseover macro with a fallback at the bottom.
